description: MediLink (SAP Hackfest 2026 prototype) - roles: pharmacist, approver, partner, admin; system = BPA technical user

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.pharmacist
scopes.description: Hospital pharmacist: cover board, requests, supplier review, receipt, ledger, onboarding

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.approver
scopes.description: Chief pharmacist / oncologist: approve or reject transfers, verify audit chain

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.partner
scopes.description: Licensed cold-chain delivery partner: pickup scan, telemetry, route

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.admin
scopes.description: MediLink administrator: directory, trust feed, all hospitals

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.system
scopes.description: Technical user for SAP Build Process Automation callbacks (/workflow/*); granted to MediLink client-credentials tokens via authorities

attributes.name: hospital
attributes.description: MediLink hospital ID the user acts for (e.g. H1)
